channel.title: The College Fix - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The College Fix (thecollegefix.com)

item.title: Kansas could be next state to end in-state tuition for illegal immigrants
item.description: Kansas lawmakers are considering a bill to end in-state tuition for illegal immigrants, following Attorney General Kobach's warning of a potential lawsuit.

item.title: Stanford newspaper sues State Dept over international students’ right to free speech
item.description: A federal court is allowing a lawsuit by the Foundation for Individual Rights and Expression to move forward against the Trump administration. The case argues that noncitizens in the U.S. legally should not fear deportation for their speech.

item.title: Foreign countries gave $67 billion to U.S. universities: Education Dept report
item.description: Qatar is the largest foreign donor to American universities, contributing $7.7 billion since 1986, according to a new U.S. Education Department report.

item.title: Police refute claim that black Virginia Tech professor was victim of racist attack
item.description: Police have refuted claims that a Virginia Tech professor was the victim of a racist attack, stating their investigation found no evidence of racial bias. The incident, involving juveniles throwing snow/ice and playing music, was deemed not targeted or threatening despite the professor's concerns over white youth singing along to racial slurs.

item.title: Bari Weiss lecture canceled at UCLA amid protest concerns
item.description: CBS News leader Bari Weiss's lecture at UCLA has been canceled due to security concerns and significant opposition from students and faculty. Nearly 11,000 signed a petition demanding the cancelation, and at least one faculty leader threatening to resign if Weiss appeared.

item.title: WATCH: Spending a semester in D.C.? Students break down what it’s really like.
item.description: The College Fix's Pride Haggerty takes to the streets of Washington D.C. to ask students about what they like and dislike about spending a semester in the nation's capitol.

item.title: House Ed Committee questions mayor who didn’t send police to Northwestern encampment
item.description: A U.S. House leader is questioning Evanston Mayor Daniel Biss for not sending police to help Northwestern University, as requested, during a pro-Palestinian protest.

item.title: Ed. Dept. agrees to scrap ‘unconstitutional’ race preferences in federal PhD grant program
item.description: 'That means the McNair Post-Baccalaureate Achievement Program–a federal program distributing roughly $60 million annually to help students pursue graduate education–will no longer discriminate based on race.'

item.title: Former atheist neurosurgeon gives ‘case for existence of the soul’ in talk at Cornell
item.description: Professor of neurosurgery details unexplainable phenomena regarding mind-brain relationship during recent Cornell University guest lecture.

item.title: Kent State U. professor caught on camera: ‘They want to keep the white men in power’
item.description: The five-minute edited video released by AIM shows a professor discussing how DEI is still a valued ideology in some classrooms.
